I’ve been doing knee rehab with Man for the past 11 months after ACL surgery and I’ve been so impressed with his knowledge and skills. He focuses on functional movements, fascia work and other methods you don’t usually find in Chiang Mai. My mobility/strength have improved so much and he’s helped me work through hiccups along the way and helped me stay optimistic through a very long recovery.
If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a physio, I 1000% recommend this clinic!

Perfect and professional physio massage clinic! 😍👌🏼

I had a neck pain and lower back pain and numbness in my arm. I got a professional massage and ultrasound and also some exercises to do at home. 😊 It costed me 900 THB. Only cash.

My therapist was miss Wa, she was so kind and friendly. And the staff also speak english - I made an appointment through their Facebook page and I was able to come that day. 😊

text: I was looking for a PT who knows therapy from a fascia perspective then I found Chiang Mai Sport Clinic! Not only are they familiar with Anatomy Train systems, they also know really advance therapy like Neurokineptic Therapy (NKT). These are all modalities popular in the US but hard to find abroad. Highly recommend this clinic- the true definition for hidden gem!!

Highly recommend this clinic! I came in with a hip injury and after a couple of sessions/following the exercises recommended I was feeling so much better! My physio, Man, is super talented and knowledgeable. Thank you so much! 🙏🏻 …

When it comes to physiotherapy, injuries and physical pain what i value most is a human approach mixed with top notch skills and professionalism.

This place was recommended to me by one of the most respected physiotherapists in Chiang Mai if not in Thailand.

All the staff are very kind and highly trained.They really care about helping you feel better, pay attention to every detail and put a lot of effort into making sure you make progress and walk out of there feeling better than you came in.

This clinic ticks all the boxes and they will go out of their way to help you with whatever issues you may encounter. I come here for rehab after a nasty fracture, prehab for a complex reconstruction surgery, weekly sports massages to maintain my high intensity training routine and will also come here for rehab after my surgery.

One of the best if not the best physiotherapy and sport clinics in Chiang Mai! I've recommended it to all of my friends with different issues, they have started going there as well and they are very happy with the quality of the services!

CM Sport Clinic was recommended to me because after two knee surgeries my leg wouldn’t straighten. I’ve been working with Man for a couple of months and he has my leg feeling better than it has in a decade. I’m back to jogging with I never thought would happen. Extremely pleased, and I highly recommend CM Sport Clinic.

Thank you Man!

had what i thought was an ankle injury from muay thai, so painful i couldn’t train. ended up being a hip/glute related injury which put pressure on my ankle and calf. after a massage, stretch and exercises given to do i feel infinitely better after one session. i go to physio every week back in australia and this is the only one i’ll go to here. Western style physio, very hands on, would 100% recommend!

They helped me with my ongoing shoulder problems that prevented me from performing any push exercises. I can only recommend coming here they used an exercise and massage based approach for my issue. The staff is super friendly and flexible on appointments.
Very good and knowledgeable doctors. They helped me with a partial bicep tendon rupture. If you are in Chiang Mai and looking for sports doctors, this clinic is the best choice.

The service here was good, but they weren’t able to help me fix my sciatica and I wonder if the exercises they gave me, such as deadlifts contributed to no recovery. The metal bar they used on my legs for some form of massage/torture was also pretty brutal and it didn’t seem worth the pain.

I just have been to the Chaingmai Sport Clinic and can highly recommend it! The place looks really nice and perfect for everyone who has pain and want to do more than just a massage! My physiotherapist took her time, helped me a lot, explained me what the issue is and how to cure it with exercises! Highly recommended!
Great place to get treated for any issues or check up on your body imbalances and get directed on how to fix it.

I had an ongoing shoulder injury that had been an issue for several months. They worked on this and within 3-4 sessions had me back to complete fitness. They’re clearly knowledgeable and are specialists in sports injuries. They provided clear instructions on rehab exercises backed up with videos. I highly recommend them!

If you live in Chiangmai and looking for  Sport massage. I will recommend this place so far so good. I am a personal trainer who working for the competitors team(body builders)all of my clients who has serious problems are in their hands and we work together done many cases well. Recommended
Such an improvement to my long standing back problem.  Combination of exercises and massage really showed results.   Therapist Man very knowledgeable and insightful.  Thank you Man.

This doctor is great. I had an upper back pain due to muay thai training. After a very careful and caring inspection the doctor found an imbalance in my shoulders. He, then, proceeded to give me the exercises and instructions I need to recover. Merry Christmas to all

I have been here a few times. Staff is excellent

Shout out to Therapist Um

higly recommend

Very good service and the most professional approach I have seen from a physio so far.
Skillful analysis. Helped with pain after one session and gave exercises to prevent injury in the future.
Big thanks to doctors for fixing my leg problem. Recommended!

The physiotherapist who treated me was very professional, easy to communicate with, and very attentive.
I arrived at the appointment unable to stretch my right leg due to pain in the upper part of the back of my thigh, but by the middle of the session I was able to stretch it with zero pain.
I think he's the best physiotherapist I've ever had.
I highly recommend him!!

I was blown away by the practitioner's efficiency and professionalism.

I've had shoulder pain for many months, and I left the clinic completely pain-free.
The approach and techniques are different, and the result is exceptional.

One of the worst experiences of my life. I was treated by a very young woman; I don't think she even has a degree.

I went to regain mobility in my left ankle after an accident a year ago. She focused on my left leg with gua sha and cupping for 40 minutes, giving me poor exercises to do even though I told her several times they hadn't worked for me.

In the end, she didn't touch my ankle at all during the entire session, telling me I had a problem with my glutes. Admittedly, my accident caused an imbalance, but the main problem is my ankle.

I insisted she treat my ankle, telling her exactly what she should be doing, even though she was the doctor.

In the end, I had excruciating pain in my ankle and leg for days afterward. Her amateurish approach made my problem worse.

I went to the clinic in 2023 because I had chronic ankle pain from running for many years. I had sought treatment at many places without success. The clinic helped address the root cause of the problem, allowing me to run again and the pain disappeared. The treatment was excellent and the staff were very friendly.

I recommend this clinic for people who exercise regularly or are athletes, and who experience chronic, recurring injuries like I did. Try calling to schedule an appointment in advance. The clinic owner is very attentive to treatment and provides excellent education on exercise for rehabilitation and injury prevention.

I highly recommend this physiotherapy clinic. They genuinely focus on identifying and treating the root cause of your problem rather than just masking symptoms or telling you to stop exercising.

The approach here is movement-based: instead of prescribing rest or painkillers, they work with your body to restore proper function. The team is highly professional and clearly experienced in working with athletes.

I’m active in tennis, cycling, and gym training, and I came in with two issues: shoulder pain and numbness in my thigh. Both problems were resolved fairly quickly.

My treatment included physiotherapy sessions, cupping, and hands-on muscle release techniques. Most importantly, they taught me specific exercises to activate the correct muscles, improve strength, and build an effective warm-up routine for tennis.

Overall, I’m very satisfied with the results and the level of care.
